claims.text: The paper introduces new metrics for evaluating multi-span question answering systems.
The proposed model achieves a 59.28% exact-match F1 score and a 76.50% partial-match F1 score, indicating the effectiveness of the new evaluation metrics.
The evaluation metrics are designed to assess multi-span QA systems across different tasks, reflecting a more realistic QA setup.
